posts.title: The finalists for SPFBO 11
posts.description: 300 contestants are being narrowed to 10 finalists for the 11th time! Finalists for SPFBO 11 The Self-Published Fantasy Blog-Off finalists are listed and and are being scored on this page. The process of selection is documented here . The champion will be declared on or before December 30th 2026. click on any score on the table for the associated review Scores for the finalists: The Matrix! Blogs

posts.title: New French covers for The Broken Empire!
posts.description: Since 2011 when Prince of Thorns was published in France, Bragelonne have used artwork very similar to the covers produced for the trilogy by Jason Chan. But recently, they've reissued the books with a very different art vibe. All three by Mikael Bourgouin! Many of my favourite fantasy books have appeared under a variety of covers over the decades, and it's fun to have a new set for The Broken Emp

posts.title: Daughter of Ruin has a cover!
posts.description: Once more, Tom Roberts has worked his magic. Feast your eyes! (The cover here is followed by the rough and then the line drawing - both stages that cover artists share with the publisher art department to make sure everything's heading in the right direction.) The book comes out in March and you can pre-order it from many fine bookshops! And Amazon UK & (soon) US . Join my Patreon. Join my 3-email
